Momcozy Air 1 vs M5 Smart: Which Wearable Breast Pump Is Right for You?

Full Specifications at a Glance
When you compare the Momcozy Air 1 vs M5 Smart, the choice comes down to how much you pump, where you pump, and how much you want to spend. Both pumps connect to the Momcozy app and fit inside your bra. But the Air 1 targets moms who need a slim profile and a charging case for all-day freedom, while the M5 Smart delivers solid app-connected performance at a much friendlier price.
Not sure where to start? This table zeroes in on what actually matters when choosing between these two pumps.
Charging case doubles as power bank for up to 15 sessions

Both the Air 1 and the M5 Smart connect to the Momcozy app via Bluetooth, so you can adjust pumping settings and track your sessions from your phone without reaching under your clothing.
The M5 Smart app lets you start and stop pumping, switch between modes, adjust suction levels (1 to 9), and log your milk output by session, day, week, or month. You can control both pumps at the same time or adjust each side individually. You can also operate the M5 Smart using the physical buttons on the pump directly without the app.
The Air 1 goes further. It includes everything the M5 Smart app offers, plus three exclusive pumping patterns available only through the app. Milk Boost ™ uses scientifically optimized rhythms to help enhance milk production. Milk Relief ™ gently eases engorgement while expressing milk. MyFlow ™ lets you fully customize your own stimulation, expression, or mixed mode pattern. You can save your favorite patterns and build routines that work best for your body.
M5 Smart Wearable Breast Pump – Upgraded with App Control
Momcozy Air 1 Ultra-slim Breast Pump
The Air 1 app also features Automatic mode switching , which automatically transitions from Stimulation mode (let-down trigger) to S12 Pro Expression mode so you do not have to adjust settings mid-session. Real-time milk tracking shows a visual fill indicator at 60 ml, 120 ml, and 180 ml, and sends a push notification when the collector is nearly full. The M5 Smart does not support Milk Boost™, Milk Relief ™, or MyFlow ™.
Overall Shape, Size, and Components
The M5 Smart has a semi-circular shape measuring 5.04 in x 4.61 in x 2.91 in (128 mm x 117 mm x 74 mm). It comes in two colors: Cozy Red and Quill Grey. The pump has 5 main parts (motor, flange, diaphragm, valve, milk collector), and includes a USB-C charging cable and a flange cover.
The Air 1 has a teardrop shape measuring 4.92 in x 4.33 in x 2.40 in (125 mm x 110 mm x 61 mm). It comes in one color and has 6 main parts (motor, flange, diaphragm, valve, milk collector, milk collector back cover), and includes both a USB Type-C cable and a magnetic charging cable, plus a flange cover. At just 2.4 inches (6.1 cm) thin, it is over 20% slimmer than other conventional pumps. For a closer look at the Air 1 design, watch this overview video .
The Air 1 also has a flat base, so you can set it down on a desk or table without worrying about it tipping over and spilling your milk. The M5 Smart has a rounded base, so you need to

pour the milk into a clean storage container right after removing the pump.
The M5 Smart features Momcozy's patented DoubleFit™ flange with a horizontal pumping angle that mimics the natural curvature of a baby's mouth during nursing. This design improves pumping efficiency by 28.2% and reduces leakage by 10%.
The Air 1 uses soft, flexible 50A silicone flanges that gently conform to your breast shape for added comfort during longer sessions.
Both pumps include a 24 mm flange and three flange inserts for S9 Pro/S12 Pro (17 mm, 19 mm, and 21 mm). If you need a 27 mm breast pump flange for larger nipple sizes, the M5 Smart offers it as a separate purchase. This option is not currently available for the Air 1.
The M5 Smart milk collector holds 5.4 oz (160 ml) and has a rounded base. The Air 1 milk collector holds 6 oz (180 ml) and has a flat, stable base that sits on a surface without tipping, a helpful detail for busy pumping sessions.
The M5 Smart has an LED screen showing your current mode, suction level (1 to 9), and battery status at startup. The Air 1 has no LED screen and uses a simple indicator light instead: solid white for full battery, solid red for low battery (one cycle left), flashing green while charging, and solid green when fully charged. All detailed monitoring on the Air 1 happens through the app.
Both pumps offer three standard modes. Stimulation Mode uses a quick, short sucking pattern to trigger your let-down reflex. Expression Mode switches to a slow, deep suction to draw out milk efficiently. Mixed Mode begins with a fast pattern and then transitions to a slow, deep pattern.
The Air 1 offers 15 suction levels while the M5 Smart offers 9. Both pumps include a 30-minute auto shut-off and a memory function that remembers your last-used settings. Here is a detailed look at the vacuum and cycle speed ranges:
Air 1: 54-90 / M5 Smart: 50-120
Air 1: 25-60 / M5 Smart: 23-57
The Air 1's 15 suction levels give you finer control over intensity, which is especially helpful if you are sensitive to pressure changes or working through supply challenges. Note that the exclusive app modes (Milk Boost™, Milk Relief™, MyFlow™) are available on the Air 1 only, not the M5 Smart.
The M5 Smart charges via USB Type-C in about 120 minutes and provides up to 180 minutes of use, approximately 6 pumping sessions at 30 minutes each.
The Air 1 offers two charging methods: a USB Type-C cable and a magnetic charging cable. The pump battery charges in about 140 minutes and provides 180 minutes of use. For a walkthrough of how to use the Air 1 charging case, watch this video .
The standout advantage of the Air 1 is its wireless charging case . The case holds up to 1,800 mAh and powers up to 15 pumping sessions, giving you approximately 5 days of use without needing a wall outlet. Simply place the pump into the case and it charges wirelessly. The M5 Smart comes with a hard-shell carrying case for protection, but it does not charge your pump.
The Air 1 weighs 9.2 oz (260 g) and operates at under 45 dB , making it one of the quietest wearable pumps available and quiet enough to use during video conferences or in shared office spaces. The M5 Smart weighs 8.2 oz (232 g) and operates at under 48 dB , which is still very discreet for most everyday environments.
The Air 1's transparent top panel lets you visually confirm nipple alignment without undressing, which saves time and reduces guesswork when you are out and about.
Keeping your pump clean is essential because germs grow quickly in breast milk residue. Both pumps follow the same core cleaning steps.
After every use, disassemble all parts that contacted your breast or milk. Rinse them immediately with cold water, then wash with warm soapy water in a clean basin used only for baby feeding items. Rinse again with clean water and air dry on a clean dish towel or paper towel. Never pat parts dry with a cloth towel as this can transfer germs.
For daily sanitization of breast pumps , place the disas

sembled milk-contact parts in a pot of water, bring to a boil, and boil for 5 to 10 minutes. Make sure parts do not touch the sides of the pot to avoid warping. Remove with clean tongs and air dry completely before reassembling.
Never put the motor unit, charging cable, or adapter in water or a dishwasher. Wipe the motor with 70% isopropyl alcohol wipes only. The Air 1 has one extra part to clean (the milk collector back cover). Replace silicone valves and diaphragms every 1 to 3 months depending on your pumping frequency.
Both pumps go together in under 30 seconds. Always wash your hands first, and let boiled parts cool completely before touching them.

The M5 Smart double pump is priced at $199.99 . The Air 1 double pump is priced at $369.99 . That is a $170 difference. The Air 1's higher cost reflects its ultra-slim design, quieter operation, larger milk collector, charging case with power bank capability, additional professional app modes, and auto mode switching. Both pumps include a carrying case and a one-year warranty.
Choose the Momcozy M5 Smart if:
You want reliable app-connected pumping at a budget-friendly price.
You prefer a pump you can operate with physical buttons without needing your phone.
You want a 27 mm flange option available for larger nipple sizes.
You primarily pump at home or in comfortable environments where whisper-quiet operation is not a must.
You want excellent everyday value without paying for features you may not use.
You pump frequently away from home and need a wireless charging case that supports up to 15 sessions without a wall outlet.
You need to pump in very quiet environments such as shared offices or public spaces.
You want access to Milk Boost™, Milk Relief™, and MyFlow™ to address low supply, engorgement, or to personalize your pumping rhythm.
You value a flat-base milk collector that sits stably on a desk without tipping.
You want finer suction control across 15 levels and a transparent top for easy nipple alignment.
You prioritize an ultra-slim, discreet profile at just 2.4 inches (6.1 cm) thin.

The Momcozy Air 1 vs M5 Smart comparison really comes down to lifestyle. If you want dependable app-connected pumping at an accessible price, the M5 Smart delivers everything you need. If your days involve commuting, travel, or pumping in busy shared spaces, the Air 1's slim profile, quiet motor, and all-in-one charging case make it a powerful companion for life on the move . Either way, you get hands-free pumping designed around real moms.
